title: Not All Countries Celebrate Thanksgiving: On the Cultural Dominance in Large Language Models
findings: LLMs like ChatGPT and GPT-4 demonstrate a strong bias towards English/Western cultural values, including those related to religion. When prompted in non-English languages on topics such as the importance of God or religious faith, the models' responses align with English cultural norms rather than the norms of the prompt language's culture.
